description: This file declares the ResourceManager class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for resource management within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, and resource control functions, as well as constants and internal data members.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: A class implementing plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for managing resources, including methods for setting AV blocking, retrieving blocked applications, and reserving TTS resources.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set AV blocked status via JSON RPC.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get list of blocked AV applications via JSON RPC.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resource via JSON RPC.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapperForApps
methods.description: Wrapper method to reserve TTS resources for multiple applications via JSON RPC.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Internal method to set AV blocked status for a client.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve list of applications with AV blocked status.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Internal method to reserve TTS resource for a client.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Internal method to reserve TTS resources for multiple clients.
